message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Earnings Acceleration", "construction": "Compute the change in quarterly earnings growth rate: (most recent quarterly EPS - EPS one quarter ago) minus (EPS one quarter ago - EPS two quarters ago), divided by stock price. Use data from quarterly filings.", "rationale": "Rapid acceleration in earnings growth may signal underappreciated improvement in fundamentals not yet reflected in prices.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Debt Change Yield", "construction": "Calculate (total debt minus cash and short-term investments) change over the past year, divided by market capitalization.", "rationale": "Firms reducing net debt may be improving balance sheet strength, which could lead to higher subsequent returns if the market under-reacts.", "higher_returns_for": "large negative values of the measure"}, {"name": "Employee Efficiency Ratio", "construction": "Total annual sales divided by number of employees (from 10-K), then divided by market capitalization.", "rationale": "Firms with greater sales per employee relative to their market value may be more operationally efficient and undervalued by investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Recent Insider Transaction Ratio", "construction": "Sum of net purchases (insider buys minus sells) over the last 6 months, divided by shares outstanding.", "rationale": "Net insider buying may indicate undervaluation or positive private information not yet reflected in the price.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Off-Balance Sheet Commitment Ratio", "construction": "Estimated future operating lease commitments (disclosed in footnotes) divided by total assets.", "rationale": "Firms with lower off-balance sheet liabilities may have less hidden leverage risk, potentially leading to higher future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Late Filer Flag", "construction": "Indicator variable equal to 1 if the most recent 10-K or 10-Q filing was delayed beyond SEC deadline by more than 7 days, 0 otherwise.", "rationale": "Delayed filings may signal financial distress or management issues, likely penalized by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Within-Industry Dividend Initiator", "construction": "Indicator variable equal to 1 if the firm initiated a dividend in the last year, and its industry peer group dividend initiation rate is below the median.", "rationale": "Dividend initiations in low-dividend industries may provide a stronger positive signal of financial health and confidence.", "higher_returns_for": "firms flagged by the indicator"}, {"name": "Preliminary Earnings Guidance Surprise", "construction": "Difference between most recent management preliminary earnings guidance and consensus analyst forecast, divided by stock price.", "rationale": "Positive surprises in guidance may go underappreciated by the market and predict outperformance.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Write-Down Frequency", "construction": "Count of inventory write-downs taken in the last three years, from 10-K notes.", "rationale": "Frequent inventory write-downs may indicate persistent operational inefficiencies or demand misestimation.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Relative Auditor Tenure", "construction": "Years with current auditor divided by industry average auditor tenure.", "rationale": "Unusually short auditor tenures may be associated with riskier or less transparent firms.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
